package.name: TrailCurrent Logo
package.description: Tools we use day to day at TrailCurrent: deboss the logo as a multi-level relief with or without part text, emboss or deboss scannable QR codes, place Deutsch DTM 2/4/12-position connector housings as real geometry, send a body straight to Bambu Studio or Blender, and drive FreeCAD itself from Claude Code and other MCP clients via the bundled 36-tool MCP server. The qrcode Python package is bundled - no separate installation required.
